All canvas listeners share bind/dispose ownership; rebinding does not multiply wheel or keyboard panning, and disposal stops all camera input.

followUpVerification.limits: These are synthetic DOM regressions, not a browser screenshot receipt, an operating measurement, architect approval or deployment verification.
